Hero.speciality: Specialist in Ear, Nose and Throat (ENT) and Head & Neck Surgeries with the latest diagnostic and microscopic endoscopy methods.

Services.title: Medical Services
Services.subtitle: Comprehensive ENT care utilizing advanced endoscopic and precision surgical techniques.

s-01.title: Nose & Sinus Endoscopy
s-01.description: Diagnosis and endoscopic management of sinus and nasal septum conditions.

s-02.title: Microscopic Ear Surgery
s-02.description: Precision microscopic surgeries to improve hearing and treat ear diseases.

s-03.title: Endoscopic Ear Surgery
s-03.description: State-of-the-art minimally invasive endoscopic ear interventions.

s-04.title: Tonsillectomy & Adenoidectomy
s-04.description: Modern surgical techniques for both pediatric and adult patients.

s-05.title: Laryngeal & Tracheal Endoscopy
s-05.description: Comprehensive evaluation of voice, swallowing, and airway disorders.

s-06.title: Foreign Body Extraction
s-06.description: Safe, gentle endoscopic foreign body removal from ear, nose, and throat.

s-07.title: Snoring & Sleep Apnea Surgery
s-07.description: Assessment and surgical management of snoring causes when indicated.

s-08.title: Functional Rhinoplasty
s-08.description: Restoring nasal airway function while preserving natural cosmetic contours.

s-09.title: Otoplasty (Prominent Ear Correction)
s-09.description: Aesthetic and corrective ear reshaping for children and adults.
